entities.summary: Luke Douglas Kennard is an American professional basketball player for the Los Angeles Lakers of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils and was drafted by the Detroit Pistons with the 12th pick in the 2017 NBA draft. He has also played for the Los Angeles Clippers, Memphis Grizzlies, and Atlanta Hawks. He currently ranks second in NBA history in career three-point field goal percentage and first amongst active players.
